excerpt.zh:
一切转瞬即逝。

在我们国土内邪恶的终末光环突然消失了，将一切也随之带走。恒星坍缩成黑洞，行星原地蒸发，只剩下震耳欲聋的寂静。似乎我们抗击光环的努力起到了一些缓和作用，尽可能保留了一点。

究竟是什么疯子激起了这种毁灭性的力量也许永远不得而知了。
excerpt.en:
In an instant, it was all gone.

The malevolent Aura of the End present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead. I

texts.en:
In an instant, it was all gone.

The malevolent Aura of the End present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead. It seems our efforts to repel the aura have had some mitigating effects, preserving what little we could.

Whatever madness invoked such destructive power may be forever unknown.
